name: Citizenship by Registration -- Descent (Full-Age Person Born Abroad to a Nigerian-Citizen Ancestor)

requirements.blocker_text: Evidence of Nigerian citizenship of either parent, a grandparent, or a great-grandparent.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of Nigerian citizenship of parent/grandparent/great-grandparent
Residence permit and passport bio-data pages

sources.title: Citizenship and Business Department, Federal Ministry of Interior, Nigeria -- Citizenship Requirements: 'Citizenship by Registration (Section 26(2B))' document checklist requires applicants to 'Upload Evidence Of Nigerian Citizenship Of Either Parent/Grand Parent/Great Grand Parent'

Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 1999 (as amended), Chapter III -- Section 26(1)(b): registration eligibility for 'full-age persons born outside Nigeria with a citizen grandparent', subject to Presidential satisfaction of good character, domicile intent, and oath compliance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Nigeria). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 candb.interior.gov.ng document checklist for the ancestor-evidence requirement, tier-2 constitutional text corroborating the underlying legal basis. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE FINDING: the Ministry of Interior's own operational document checklist reaches THREE generations back (parent, grandparent, OR great-grandparent), which is broader than the Constitution's own literal Section 26(1)(b) text (which speaks only of a citizen grandparent) -- this dataset models the Ministry's actual practice since that reflects what an applicant will encounter, but flags the discrepancy: it may indicate the Ministry's interpretation extends beyond the strict constitutional wording, or that the great-grandparent option applies through a different registration provision not fully separated out in either source. No residence-duration or age-floor requirement beyond 'full age' was found; citizenship_after_months set to 0 rather than an invented figure. DISCLOSED BUT NOT MODELED AS A HARD REQUIREMENT: Section 26 also requires the President's satisfaction of good character, domicile intent, and oath compliance (tier-2 sourced, citizenshiprightsafrica.org) -- omitted from requirement_groups here to keep this file's hard requirements cleanly tier-1, since only the ancestor-evidence condition itself is independently tier-1 confirmed via the Ministry's own document checklist. dual_citizenship_allowed is FALSE per the same Section 28 forfeiture rule as ng_citizenship_naturalisation.json, since registration is not citizenship by birth. Distinct from ng_returning_nigerian_by_birth.json, which is for people who WERE THEMSELVES Nigerian citizens and renounced -- this route is for descendants who never held Nigerian citizenship themselves.
